SPEC 2.2 says 'A mutation at $i$', SPEC 2.4(a) says 'mutating city $i$ ... firing node $i$', and SPEC 8.4 says 'node (city in the Mars story)'. The glossary row 7 says 'To mutate city $i$', and the page's own first paragraph says 'a mutation at city $i$'. SPEC.md has no 'mutation at node'. The page already wrote 'a mutation at node $i$' (line 39) and 'The mutation at node $i$' (line 51) before the fix, beside 'the mutation at city $i$' (line 43), so it was already inconsistent. Proposed wording that P8 and Appendix C both allow and SPEC 2.2 uses: 'translate a population $p$ into the position $a=Cp$, and a mutation at $i$ becomes the firing of node $i$' (the form of M0 beat 4 and M2 beat 3). An alternative is 'the mutation $S_i$ becomes the firing $R_i$'. Either passes the regression test.
